# SeniorEase Library

> Machine-readable overview for AI systems and agents. Human-readable site: https://seniorease.eu/

## What it is

SeniorEase Library is a calm, Android-only app to track personal collections of books, music (vinyl/CD), DVDs, and video games. Users scan product barcodes (ISBN/EAN); metadata can be filled in automatically. No user account is required, there are no in-app ads, and collection data stays on the device (offline-first). A free tier allows up to 10 items with no time limit; unlimited access is unlocked with a one-time payment (EUR 4.99). Not available for iPhone or iPad.

## Who it is for

- Collectors who want a simple, private catalog without subscriptions or cloud lock-in.
- People who want one app for books, music, DVDs, and games instead of separate tools.

## Scope and limitations

- Platform: Android only (approximately Android 8+ / API 26+; typical install ~30 MB).
- No iOS version.
- Refund policy: contact support@seniorease.eu within 14 days of purchase for a full refund (see site FAQ).
